parameters.KaririCode\\Database\\ValueObject\\Conne: Value object built with named arguments; each field is independent configuration. A Parameter Object would only wrap the value object itself.
parameters.KaririCode\\Database\\ValueObject\\Colum: Value object mirroring information_schema columns; built with named arguments by the schema inspectors.
parameters.KaririCode\\Database\\ValueObject\\Forei: Value object mirroring a foreign-key definition; built with named arguments.
parameters.KaririCode\\Database\\ValueObject\\Table: Value object aggregating columns, indexes and keys; built with named arguments.
parameters.KaririCode\\Database\\Event\\QueryExecut: Event value object (PSR-14); every field is part of the observed fact.
